indication_area: Neovascular age-related macular degeneration and other retinal disease (biosimilar to Lucentis)
geography: United States (the 'U.S.' column of Biogen's product revenue table; Biogen's Total column also holds Rest of World from 2023Q1)
formulation: injection, 10 mg/mL solution in a single-dose vial
moa: VEGF-A inhibitor (ranibizumab antibody fragment, biosimilar to Lucentis)

approval_evidence.quote: Approval Date(s) and History, Letters, Labels, Reviews for BLA 761202 Original Approvals or Tentative Approvals ... 09/17/2021 ORIG-1 Approval

launch_evidence.quote: In the second quarter of 2022 Biogen and Samsung Bioepis Co., Ltd. launched BYOOVIZ (ranibizumab-nuna), a biosimilar referencing LUCENTIS, in the United States.

notes: Scope is the U.S. column of Biogen's product revenue table (USD millions, one decimal). The Total column adds a Rest of World component (0.4 in 2023Q1, rising to 19.4 for 2025) that Biogen's 2024 releases date to 'certain international markets in 2023', so the Total is not constant-scope; the U.S. column is printed in every release from 2022Q2 and is used for the whole series. Totals (U.S.+Rest of World) as printed: 2022Q2 0.5, 2022Q3 0.7, 2022Q4 3.1, 2023Q1 8.6, 2023Q2 7.0, 2023Q3 6.9, 2023Q4 9.2, 2024Q1 5.6, 2024Q2 13.7, 2024Q3 8.0, 2024Q4 9.3, 2025Q1 8.9, 2025Q2 8.6, 2025Q3 7.0, 2025Q4 7.9. 2022Q2 is pre-availability stocking (release footnote: launched in June 2022, commercially available in July 2022). Cross-checks: calendar-year U.S. sums 2022 0.5+0.7+3.1=4.3, 2023 8.2+7.0+6.1+7.9=29.2, 2024 3.7+10.3+4.1+4.9=23.0, 2025 4.2+2.5+2.0+4.3=13.0 equal the full-year U.S. figures printed in the Q4 releases (4.3, 29.2, 23.0, 13.0). Brand total is a single formulation (ranibizumab-nuna 10 mg/mL vial). 2026Q1 and 2026Q2 are carried forward from Biogen's 2026 releases, which still print a BYOOVIZ row in the same U.S. column after the divestiture (U.S. nil in 2026Q1; 0.1 in 2026Q2, Total 0.1). Biogen's footnotes there say the rights were sold in 2025, and the FY2025 10-K says transfer of commercialization rights for BYOOVIZ in the U.S. and Canada back to Samsung Bioepis was completed as of December 31, 2025, so these two quarters are residual items, not commercial sales, kept as printed. Samsung Bioepis (the rights holder from 2026) is not an SEC registrant; no document of it printing BYOOVIZ net sales was located (not exhaustively searched).
search_log: Listed Biogen (CIK 0000875045) filings from data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + older files), keeping every 8-K and 8-K/A with item 2.02: 25 filings 2022-02 to 2026-07; the 2022-07-20 8-K/A (0000875045-22-000023) is a re-filing of the same release and the original 8-K was used.

Downloaded the EX-99.1 earnings release of each quarter's 8-K from 2021Q4 to 2026Q2 (exhibit991-q<N><YYYY>pressrele.htm) and parsed every table row; selected the first row whose label equals the product (the three-month table; the year-to-date table follows it).
Downloaded all Biogen 10-K and 10-Q filings 2023-02 to 2026-07 and searched the text for the brand names and the revenue-note product tables.
Biogen first prints BYOOVIZ in the 2022Q2 release (rows 0.5 / nil / 0.5); the 2022Q1 release (filed 2022-05-03) has no BYOOVIZ row, consistent with the June 2022 launch.
Every quarter 2022Q2-2025Q4 is read from that quarter's own release (direct_reported); no gap between first and last quarter.
FDA: Drugs@FDA overview page for BLA 761202 prints the 09/17/2021 original approval.
Fallbacks not needed (a separately printed line exists for the whole span). Samsung Bioepis (the licensor) reports company revenue only.

2026 refresh: Biogen CIK 0000875045 submissions listed (8-K incl. Item 2.02, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K to 2026-10); Exhibit 99.1 of the Q1 2026 (8-K 0000875045-26-000042) and Q2 2026 (8-K 0000875045-26-000073) releases parsed for the BYOOVIZ row: U.S. nil and 0.1 respectively; three-month row distinguished from the six-month row (0.1 | -- | 0.1 | 6.7 | 10.8 | 17.5).
Successor rights holder Samsung Bioepis (not an SEC registrant): no BYOOVIZ net sales document located; this rung was not exhaustively searched.

reviewed_anomalies.2026Q1: Biogen divested BYOOVIZ in 2025 (U.S. and Canada rights returned to Samsung Bioepis as of 2025-12-31). The 2026Q1 U.S. column is nil: no commercial sales remain. Kept as printed.
reviewed_anomalies.2026Q2: Biogen divested BYOOVIZ in 2025. The 2026Q2 U.S. column prints 0.1, a residual item after the divestiture, not a commercial sale. Kept as printed.
